title: A true sentence, unstaged
line: A daughter films her father from a doorway: 14 years on one book, and he never turns round
proof: Sold: more than 100,000 books in about five weeks

title: The skill used on you
line: An effects teacher tips off a sea cliff, and in one frame the cliff is gone
proof: Its owner kept paying: 212 days, 5 copies of the ad

title: Begin the task on camera
line: A reader pulls out a puzzle book with its pages out of order and takes the task on
proof: Reprints of 10,000 and 70,000 ordered; seen 6.7m times

title: The pupil is the proof
line: A reading teacher lays down one card after another, and a small child reads the sentence
proof: Seen 5.6 million times, 134.9 times its usual

title: A lesson without words
line: A piano teacher drops a plush panda on slow fingers; then the pupil gets it right
proof: Seen 12.3 million times, 139.9 times its usual
